narrow.evidence: paper config num_iters100; native100AXI reads, one source per tile, no CPU-loop3cycle subtraction

zero: Only one active source; pipelined DMA allowed; no global per-transaction semaphore
full: Simultaneous source launch, finite batch; record source start/end and common overlap; not steady-state
window: Memory devices share C=(latest source RLAST-earliest source AR)/1000+1; tiles use their own source_cycles
device_util: device accepted R useful bytes in same common window/(64*C)*100
peak: Native512bit/1ns independent R channel,64B/cycle=64GB/s per memory; HBM paper uses57.6GB/s
mapping: source i->memory16+i//4, offset(i%4)*128KiB; narrow->tile15 excluding self
differences: one AXI source/tile versus9core cluster full narrow
AXI handshake timing versusDMA/core trace timing
tile_window: Per-source first AR through its own last RLAST, both edge cycles; source_cycles=(own_last_R-own_first_AR)/1000+1
window_scope: Common window applies only to memory device aggregate; per-tile percentages use individual jobs and cannot be summed
primary_window_evidence: paper scripts/plots.py75-85,280-295: per-hart stats cycles, no global max/min
